paragraphs.en: Strands Agents is an open-source SDK for building and running AI agents in Python and TypeScript. Choose Strands when you would otherwise write your own agent loop: it runs in your process with no hosted control plane, and it covers the jobs a hand-rolled loop grows into. In one SDK you get lifecycle controls (turn limits, token budgets, cancellation, stop reasons), tools and structured output , MCP , multi-agent patterns , memory and sessions , model portability , streaming , guardrails , tracing , and evals .
paragraphs.zh: Strands Agents 是一个开源 SDK，用于在 Python 和 TypeScript 中构建和运行 AI 智能体。 当你原本需要自己编写智能体循环时，可以选择 Strands：它在你的进程中运行，没有托管控制平面，并且涵盖了手写循环逐渐演变成的各项任务。 在一个 SDK 中，你可以获得生命周期控制（回合限制、token 预算、取消、停止原因）、工具与结构化输出、MCP、多智能体模式、记忆与会话、模型可移植性、流式传输、护栏、追踪以及评估。

paragraphs.en: This monorepo contains Strands harness, the Python and TypeScript SDKs, the documentation site, and supporting packages:
paragraphs.zh: 此 monorepo 包含 Strands harness、Python 和 TypeScript SDK、文档站点以及支持包：

paragraphs.en: Build an agent harness. Control it end-to-end.
paragraphs.zh: 构建智能体工具框架（harness）。实现端到端的控制。

paragraphs.en: MCP, streaming, multi-agent patterns, and structured output are all built in.
paragraphs.zh: MCP、流式处理、多智能体模式和结构化输出均已内置。

paragraphs.en: The easiest way to get started is with Strands harness , a fully assembled, state-of-the-art agent. A single create_harness() (Python) or createHarness() (TypeScript) call gives you an optimized agent with benchmarked defaults for the model, tools, memory, sessions, and context management — ready to take from idea to production. Follow the harness quickstart , or see the Python Strands harness and TypeScript Strands harness packages to get started.
paragraphs.zh: 上手最简单的方式是使用 Strands harness，一个完全组装好的、最先进的智能体。 只需一次 create_harness()（Python）或 createHarness()（TypeScript）调用，即可获得一个针对模型、工具、内存、会话和上下文管理采用基准测试默认配置的优化智能体——随时可以从想法走向生产。 按照 harness 快速入门操作，或查看 Python Strands harness 和 TypeScript Strands harness 包以开始使用。

sents.en: Follow the harness quickstart , or see the Python Strands harness and TypeScript Strands harness packages to get started.
sents.zh: 按照 harness 快速入门操作，或查看 Python Strands harness 和 TypeScript Strands harness 包以开始使用。

paragraphs.en: pip install strands-harness from strands_harness import create_harness agent = create_harness () agent ( "Find the slowest test in this repo and explain why it's slow" ) TypeScript npm install @strands-agents/harness import { createHarness } from '@strands-agents/harness' const agent = await createHarness ( ) await agent . invoke ( "Find the slowest test in this repo and explain why it's slow" ) Start here to get a batteries-included agent, then drop down to the SDKs below when you want to own the agent loop and wire up tools, model providers, and memory yourself. The harness configuration reference documents every default you can override.
paragraphs.zh: pip install strands-harness from strands_harness import create_harness agent = create_harness () agent ( "找出这个仓库中最慢的测试并解释它为什么慢" ) TypeScript npm install @strands-agents/harness import { createHarness } from '@strands-agents/harness' const agent = await createHarness ( ) await agent . invoke ( "找出这个仓库中最慢的测试并解释它为什么慢" ) 从这里开始，获得一个开箱即用的智能体；当你想自己掌控智能体循环、自行接入工具、模型提供商和记忆时，再使用下面的 SDK。 智能体（harness）配置参考文档记录了你可以覆盖的每一个默认值。

paragraphs.en: The Quickstart Guide covers configuring providers (Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, and more).
paragraphs.zh: 《快速入门指南》涵盖了配置提供商（Amazon Bedrock、Anthropic、OpenAI、Gemini、Ollama 等）的内容。

paragraphs.en: The Strands Harness SDK lets you go deeper and control every part of the agent: the loop, tools, model providers, memory, sessions, and hooks. You can dive into the SDK after working with Strands harness or if you prefer building your own harness from the ground up when the assembled defaults aren't enough.
paragraphs.zh: Strands Harness SDK 让你能够更深入地控制智能体的每一个部分：循环、工具、模型提供商、记忆、会话和钩子。 你可以在使用 Strands harness 之后深入研究 SDK，或者当组装好的默认配置不够用时，如果你更倾向于从零开始构建自己的 harness，也可以直接使用 SDK。

sents.en: The Strands Harness SDK lets you go deeper and control every part of the agent: the loop, tools, model providers, memory, sessions, and hooks.

paragraphs.en: pip install strands-agents strands-agents-tools from strands import Agent from strands_tools import calculator agent = Agent ( tools = [ calculator ]) agent ( "What is the square root of 1764" ) The Python SDK README covers tools, model providers, MCP, and bidirectional streaming.
paragraphs.zh: pip install strands-agents strands-agents-tools from strands import Agent from strands_tools import calculator agent = Agent ( tools = [ calculator ]) agent ( "What is the square root of 1764" ) Python SDK 的 README 涵盖了工具、模型提供商、MCP 和双向流式传输。

paragraphs.en: To build a Strands agent in TypeScript, install the SDK in a Node.js 22+ ESM project ( "type": "module" ):
paragraphs.zh: 要在 TypeScript 中构建 Strands 智能体，请在 Node.js 22+ 的 ESM 项目（"type": "module"）中安装 SDK：

paragraphs.en: npm install @strands-agents/sdk import { Agent } from '@strands-agents/sdk' const agent = new Agent ( ) const result = await agent . invoke ( 'What is the square root of 1764?' ) console . log ( result ) new Agent() uses Amazon Bedrock by default, so configure AWS credentials or pass another model. Start with the TypeScript quickstart to configure a model provider, run your first agent, and add tools. Use the TypeScript API reference for the full SDK surface, or explore more examples in the TypeScript SDK README .
paragraphs.zh: npm install @strands-agents/sdk import { Agent } from '@strands-agents/sdk' const agent = new Agent ( ) const result = await agent . invoke ( '1764 的平方根是多少？' ) console . log ( result ) new Agent() 默认使用 Amazon Bedrock，因此请配置 AWS 凭证或传入其他模型。 从 TypeScript 快速入门开始，配置模型提供商、运行你的第一个智能体，并添加工具。 使用 TypeScript API 参考文档了解完整的 SDK 接口，或在 TypeScript SDK README 中探索更多示例。

sents.en: npm install @strands-agents/sdk import { Agent } from '@strands-agents/sdk' const agent = new Agent ( ) const result = await agent . invoke ( 'What is the square root of 1764?' ) console . log ( result ) new Agent() uses Amazon Bedrock by default, so configure AWS credentials or pass another model.
